name: Threat Guard
short_description: EVM address, phishing domain and risk-flag screening for wallets, contracts and links
description: Security screening agent for the EVM ecosystem. Checks any wallet or contract address for scam and sanctions exposure (cybercrime, money laundering, mixer use, malicious contracts created, phishing activity, fake KYC), verifies whether a domain or URL is a known phishing site, and returns a full raw-flag breakdown on demand. Every report states a HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / CLEAN verdict and lists the individual GoPlus security flags that were raised, so you can judge severity yourself. Built for traders and deployers who want to vet a counterparty, a contract or a link before interacting with it. Data source: GoPlus Labs Security API, free tier, no API key required.
